POST_adoption: Same rubric on POST; independently judge whether D0/geometric cleanup changes the role. A shared edge or closeness must not decide the semantic label.

POST_body_complete.NO: An obvious major body/support region is missing or the overall object has substantially collapsed.
POST_body_complete.UNKNOWN: Cannot resolve body completeness from the supplied views; retain ambiguity.
POST_body_complete.YES: A recognizable overall chair organization with a plausible seat/back/support system remains visible. This does not certify structural strength, watertightness, absence of local cracks, or exact leg count/style.

RAW_adoption.NO: A clearly separate replacement seat or wrong functional layer is visible, or C is plainly detached from the intended seat organization.
RAW_adoption.UNKNOWN: Its seat role is ambiguous due to overlap, plausible thickness, occlusion or insufficient visible evidence. Do not infer NO from uncertainty.
RAW_adoption.YES: The blue C plausibly serves as the seating surface within the generated chair organization; no clearly separate dominant replacement seat is visible. Small gaps do not by themselves disprove adoption.

additional_rules: Do not demand the unique source-parent style.
Do not equate visible blue pixels with adoption.
Do not equate legal connectivity or geometric touching with adoption; numerical topology is scored independently.
Do not relabel a method to make relative rankings coherent; anonymous aliases can change between requests.
For thin layers/occluded contours keep UNKNOWN unless a clear visible alternative seat or plausible complete seat role resolves it.
Record a short concrete visual reason for every output, including meaningful differences or uncertainty.
View every full request page, not contact sheets alone. Additional original viewing is permitted; no mesh editing, model sampling, metrics, or label-map reading.
basis: Existing registration actual-use/body rubric, made explicit for separate blinded reviewers; no numerical reward or scoring change
forbidden_for_reviewer: model directories or numerical score tables
training reviews or old model adoption labels
limitations: Model-label blind AI review, same model family; not human validation or full geometric certification.
scope: 32 requests x anonymous A/B/C; same original RAW/POST three views and two sections
